stages.name: coalescer
stages.contract: Serialize synchronous barrier capture with registration. Retain latest pending snapshot while a worker awaits or admits; atomically end only when no snapshot remains. No admission authority.

stages.name: idle_consumers
stages.contract: Await observations, reread durable work, use ordinary admission. Goal fails closed on pending-user query errors. Identical typed hook rejection suppresses only automatic retry in same runtime; explicit starts remain allowed.
